learning_outcomes.text: Students know manufacturing-appropriate design rules and can apply them to practical examples.
They know mechanical equivalent diagrams and can analyze application cases and determine and evaluate the appropriate mechanical equivalent diagram.
They know the common procedures of the FKM guideline for general strength calculation on cross-sections.
They know common procedures for calculating connections and connecting elements and can apply them.
They know the application possibilities and strength calculation methods for detachable and non-detachable connections as well as rotary motion elements.
They know friction-locked and form-fitting drive elements as well as mechatronic elements of drive technology.
They have a fundamental understanding of constructive problem solutions.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the subject area of machine elements
Fundamental remarks on the design process
assessment_rules: The course grade for "Maschinenelemente I/II" is based on a written examination (Klausur) with a duration of 120 minutes. This examination accounts for 100% of the module grade.
